subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw support resetSessionEntryLifecycle and its locked-harness owner handoff as a permanent Plugin SDK contract, or keep this lifecycle operation internal while retaining the Microsoft Teams fix?
rationale: The observable Teams bug and implementation are well supported, but repository policy treats Plugin SDK expansion and cross-owner session teardown as compatibility-sensitive API direction that automated review cannot choose.

options.title: Approve the narrow public contract
options.body: Accept the documented owner checks, stale-signal guards, rollback behavior, and harness reset handoff as the supported generic plugin lifecycle-reset API.

options.title: Keep lifecycle reset internal
options.body: Refactor the Teams handler through a host-owned internal service and remove the new callable Plugin SDK surface before merge.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Leave the linked issue open if maintainers do not want either a public reset primitive or an internal host orchestration path yet.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow public contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented owner checks, stale-signal guards, rollback behavior, and harness reset handoff as the supported generic plugin lifecycle-reset API.

likelyOwner.reason: They already narrowed the lifecycle behavior on this branch and are the clearest available owner for the remaining cross-boundary API choice.
